shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement), fully simulated linked maps behaving as ONE BIG MAP: live plumb see-below view, biome-driven sky plateaus (modded biomes), full cross-level parity suite (work/haul/supply incl. fuel+surgery+transporters, trade beacons column-wide, mech recharge, gear/apparel/drug probes, gatherings, childcare, install ferry, container storage), priority-aware work, probe-gated robot migration (Misc Robots + Robots++), Achtung drags, climb animations, wide stairs, art tuner, jobs-cadence settings tab with presets, kill-switch panel, TRUE through-gap combat, pod transit + AA, elevators, opt-in threats, world integration, self-testing dev harness, modder API. body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and our UI reads as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant exception); outermost ring AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Below view PLUMB, dim 0.06. Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: real probe required (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**: semantic anchor rule (bound anchor elsewhere invalidates ANY giver answer incl. cell targets).
- **FORCED-ORDER PARITY PATTERN**: "Bring {thing} and {verb}" for sites lacking a thing the pawn's level has. Instances: build, install, refuel.
- **NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY (user-directed 2026-07-23)**: ALL our float-menu orders must read as base game — find the disabled vanilla row for the same target, inherit its orderInPriority, REMOVE it, set iconThing = target, Default priority (never High, never icon-less). Lore saved (ui). Apply to every future option.
- **ARRIVAL CONTINUATIONS MUST SELF-HEAL**: transfer-time job resolution can null (mid-toil ordering); every bring-and-X continuation gets a known-payload fallback + one-shot 15t delayed retry via ABGameComp. Seamlessness is a requirement, not best-effort.
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair art; risers host atlases. Climb animations vanilla pipeline. **PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP** (docs/).

## 2026-07-23 LATEST (all compile green, needs relaunch)
- **Art tuner copy/paste**: clipboard Snapshot (drawSize + all offsets); Copy/Paste buttons row in the tuner window; paste applies live + marks touched for bake.
- **Refuel continuation fix (user: pawn climbs, then stops until re-commanded)**: FinishOnSite hardened — captures the dropped payload; refuel fallback feeds it directly (JobDefOf.Refuel(target, dropped) when the giver's own resolution nulls); one-shot 15-tick retry queue (ABConstructSupply.Tick from ABGameComp) covers any transfer-time quirk; Dev log when the first attempt nulls. Applies to build/install/refuel chains alike.
- **Native float-menu styling**: AddNative helper — all three bring-and-X options now replace the disabled vanilla row (inherit orderInPriority, remove it, target icon, Default priority). Screenshot feedback resolved: no more icon-less top-row + "Cannot refuel" pair.

## USER-VERIFIED TODAY: forced cross-level refuel works (modulo the continuation fix above). Robots++ verified crossing levels (bounce fixed, dock loop fixed — full clean cycle still to confirm this run).

## BATCH BUILD (2026-07-23) — ALL P1+P2 BUILT, verification rolling
Trade beacons column-wide; refuel/vat demand + forced order; transporter manifests; surgery-bill ingredients; baby food; mech recharge routing; gear probes (apparel/weapon/drugs); non-Ideo gatherings; detectors roof/childcare/mech-repair. P3 excluded by design (Anomaly, anima, turrets).

## SAME-DAY PRIOR (verification rolling)
Install/uninstall parity; robot bounce fix; run #70 dock fix + #72 StationElsewhere; fence patch; container-storage push fix; verify sweep; Achtung drags; meditation redirect; construction supply giver + bring-and-build; jobs settings tab (5 flow checkboxes); biome-driven plateaus; climb animations + wide stairs; art tuner.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API.

## SETTINGS — six tabs; jobs tab: presets + cadence sliders + 5 flow checkboxes.
## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; DEV: Adjust art (+copy/paste; bake fold-in pending).

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots (verified) + Robots++ (crossing verified; full cycle pending). Achtung! drags (soft, unverified). Container storage destinations (unverified). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: tuner copy/paste + refuel continuation self-heal + native float-menu policy (locked + lored) built on the full parity batch. Relaunch owed for: seamless refuel chain end-to-end, native menu look, remaining batch circuit (trade/mech-charge/surgery/gear/gatherings), robot full cycle. Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
